name: Scheduler
description: Cron and deferred tasks registered with the kernel scheduler.

capabilities.name: Register Task
capabilities.description: Register a cron or deferred task defined by the plugin.

capabilities.name: Enqueue
capabilities.description: Run one of the plugin's own functions in the background, now or later, with retries; check on or cancel those jobs. Maps to kernel commands scheduler::enqueue, scheduler::job and scheduler::cancel_job.

capabilities.name: Run Jobs As A Person
capabilities.description: Let a background job run as a named account, under that person's roles and record rules, instead of as the kernel. Sensitive: the plugin chooses whom to act as. Used by `scheduler::enqueue { run_as }`.
